training.dataset: PhysioNet sleep-accel (Walch et al. 2019) 1.0.0 + PhysioNet BIDSleep (Song et al. 2026) 1.0.1

training.notes: final model, run bias-base: all 78 subjects of walch+bidsleep; training configuration walch+bid-zero: Walch + BIDSleep; BIDSleep nights have no step channel and keep the step features that algo-cli computes for them (0 steps, as the app does for a night without step records); validated by LOSO (tools/train report); decoder defaults {"durationModel":"EXPLICIT","emissionWeight":0.5,"timePriorWeight":0.0}; MLP 32x32 relu (adam, alpha=0.0001, early stopping, random_state=0, class_weight=none); policy for missing step channels: zero; training variants: instantaneous, mean2min; label statistics from instantaneous; rows: 225973; hrNorm means violate DEEP < LIGHT < REM < AWAKE (per-night EM will roll back); stage-proportion experiment (tools/train/out/prereg-bias.md) on run bias-base: candidate B (b) proportion matching b adopted; decoder {"durationModel":"EXPLICIT","emissionWeight":0.5,"priorExponent":1.0,"timePriorWeight":0.0}; stageLogBias fitted on the LOSO out-of-fold decodes of the walch subjects (both headline variants pooled) so that the decoded stage shares match the PSG shares; nap experiment (docs/prereg/prereg-naps.md) on run bias-base: candidate C-180 (b_short below 180 min) adopted; sessions shorter than hybrid.shortSessionMaxMin = 180 min use stageLogBiasShort, fitted on the LOSO out-of-fold nap proxies (L in [30, 60, 90, 120] min) of the walch subjects (both headline variants pooled) so that their decoded stage shares match the PSG shares; pre-registered nap-model experiment (docs/prereg/prereg-nap-model.md): N1 (nap model + nap stageLogBias) adopted by rule (i); output policy STAGES by rule (ii)

training.dataset: nap proxies of PhysioNet sleep-accel (Walch et al. 2019) 1.0.0 + PhysioNet BIDSleep (Song et al. 2026) 1.0.1

training.notes: pre-registered nap-model experiment (docs/prereg/prereg-nap-model.md): N1 (nap model + nap stageLogBias) adopted by rule (i); output policy STAGES by rule (ii); MLP 32x32 relu (adam, alpha=0.0001, early stopping, random_state=0, class_weight=none); decoder {"durationModel":"EXPLICIT","emissionWeight":0.5,"timePriorWeight":0.0} (napMode.hybrid); proxies: onset L [30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 170] min + ends-in-wake windows (<= 3 per night); rows 373523; nap stageLogBias fitted on the LOSO out-of-fold proxies of the 31 Walch subjects
